title: Route Guards
summary: Protect routes with guards — like blocking pages behind a login.
heading: Route Guards

blocks.text: A guard is a small function the router runs before (or after) navigating. It decides whether the user is allowed to go there — for example, blocking a dashboard unless the user is logged in.
A modern guard is just a function of type CanActivateFn. Inside it you can inject services. Return true to allow, or a UrlTree (from router.parseUrl) to redirect.

blocks.label: auth.guard.ts

sections.title: Attaching the guard to a route

blocks.text: List the guard in the route's canActivate array. You can attach several guards.

blocks.label: routes

blocks.text: Now visiting /dashboard while logged out bounces the user to /login.
